core_job: For people who answer many short messages a day, in English and without sending anything to a server: paste the message you got, get three replies (casual, professional, short) that already sound like you, edit with the real system keyboard, then Copy or Share in two taps. Every reply you send is saved on the device so the app can find it again.
signature: Voice Match, on-device. (a) A voice profile measured from the replies the user actually sent: lowercase share, full-stop share, exclamation share, emoji share and top emoji, measured short forms (thx/u/ur/ok/pls/tmrw/btw/cya) and usual opener. Casual and short suggestions are rewritten to match, using fixed thresholds and only after at least 5 replies. Each suggestion shows small 'why' tags for the rules it applied, and each trait can be switched off on a Voice screen. (b) Reply memory, 'You said before': saved (incoming, reply) pairs are matched to a new message by token-overlap Jaccard of at least 0.34, and the old reply is shown word for word with its date. Pure Dart, no network, no keys. Competitors not verified: WebSearch is disabled in this session.
must: M1: A single Reply desk is the home screen (no NavigationBar/Rail shell). It has a Paste button, chat-bubble tone replies, a 'Your reply' field edited with the real system keyboard (TextField), and Copy plus Share (share_plus). A successful copy or share saves the (incoming, reply, tone, time) pair. Library, Voice and Settings open from the app bar.

M2: Signature Voice Match: VoiceProfile.fromReplies/apply with the thresholds in spec section 3, a 5-reply minimum, the professional slot left unchanged, and 'why' tags. ReplyMemory.bestMatch at >=0.34, shown word for word with its date. A Voice screen shows the measured traits, 'based on N replies', a switch per trait, and an honest 'Learning your voice: N of 5' state.

M3: Depth. Saved pairs persist, capped at 500. Old @animus/user_style phrases are migrated in, and the premium and llm_mode keys are deleted. A Library screen has search, filter chips (All/Pinned/Casual/Professional/Short), pin, edit, swipe-delete with undo, and plain-text export through the share sheet. Library, search and clipboard each get their own empty-state copy. Storage errors are reported and shown to the user.

M4: Remove dead and dishonest code: LLMMode.cloud, kApiBase, generateCloud, the JSON wire code, the onboarding mode cards, the Settings cloud tile and the 'This build has no cloud suggestions service configured' copy, the About 'this build' sentence, the http dependency, isPremium, and the unused preferredTone/avgMessageLength. The About version comes from package_info_plus. A test fails if banned strings appear in lib/.

M5: Own identity. Seed #E4572E; paper #FBF6EE / surface #FFFDF8 / ink #232838 / muted #6E6A63; dark #15181F / #1F2430 / #F3EDE2 / accent #FF7A52 (none of these 9 hexes is in any repo). Fraunces headings and Atkinson Hyperlegible body, bundled with OFL licences (URLs curl-verified 200; no other app uses them). Keycap radius-8 shapes and 18/18/18/4 bubbles, no radius 12. CupertinoIcons throughout, adaptive dialogs and switches. native_keyboard.dart becomes ReplyPad (keycaps of pinned replies and emoji); the QWERTY replica is removed.

M6: New launcher icon (vermilion keycap speech bubble on paper; no green, no check mark, no Material glyph on a gradient). New splash with background #FBF6EE (storyboard shasum no longer 3f6a9b27...). CFBundleDisplayName, CFBundleName and android:label all equal one kAppName constant with correct casing. The error_reporter friendly panel uses this app's theme and copy.

M7: Onboarding 'Teach it your voice': up to 3 optional replies to paste, Skip always visible, then the measured or 'Learning' voice, then 'Open the reply desk' (no 'Get started' or 'Start'). Own Settings copy: Your voice (trait switches, 'Erase my voice and saved replies'), Library export, About and licences. No shared Language screen.

M8: flutter analyze clean, all tests pass (baseline 270 passing, analyze clean at base_sha), and no test deleted or skipped. Tests for removed behaviour are rewritten. New tests cover VoiceProfile thresholds, ReplyMemory, storage cap and migration, the desk flow, Library, export, both onboarding paths, no NavigationBar, the Info.plist name, fonts, splash hash, and the banned-string grep. The screenshot integration test drives the new flow. Commit path-limited and push to main, never staging mobile/fastlane/** or mobile/ios/Podfile.lock (other people's uncommitted edits; share_plus will cause a Podfile.lock conflict that must be reported, not resolved).
